atomic.decision: The public package exposes VCR construction, cassette use, record modes, requests, cassettes, matchers, serializers, and persistence.
Request authority preserves URI while deriving scheme, host, port, path, body, and method projections.
Query and header projections define duplicate, blank, ordering, and single-value behavior.
Component matchers accept equivalent requests and reject a controlled mismatch.
Body matching distinguishes raw bytes while treating semantic JSON equivalently.
Cassette append publishes ordered request and response views without consuming playback.
Playback consumes repeated matching responses in order and rewind restores counters.
Public serialization round-trips semantic request and response views.
Prepared matcher policies remain invisible until commit and reopen with normalized ordered identity.
Quarantine removes an unsafe revision from the active view and compensation advances only from the exact fenced generation.
Playback sessions own one dependency-first selection, stable owner, and monotonic generation.
Session handoff and recovery fence stale owners without adding unrelated plans.
Interaction attempts distinguish prepared, completed, failed, and acknowledged state; tentative values are not current.
Cassette artifacts publish an exact-byte manifest atomically and verify every named value before visibility.
Entered patch scopes create durable reverse-order cleanup obligations and expose the next owed action after reopen.
Replay checkpoints advance only the exact next interaction and preserve position, generation, and owner across reopen.

composition.decision: VCR configuration preserves per-owner match settings and independent siblings.
Public query and header filters change only named request projections.
Built-in JSON and YAML formats preserve the same semantic interaction views.
Filesystem persistence creates parents and restores semantic interaction content.
A committed policy projects ignored query fields before applying ordinary matcher semantics.
A compensated policy becomes the provenance prerequisite of a later interaction while the quarantined revision stays recoverable.
Reopened policy and artifact views preserve the compensated generation and exact-byte causal binding.
Overlapping plan requests deduplicate one dependency-first closure without unrelated carryover.
A stale session owner cannot create or publish a later interaction attempt.
Session handoff transfers event ownership while preserving selected plans and event order.
Only an interaction admitted by the current session becomes a journal attempt.
Failure after tentative response data publishes no success while preserving reverse cleanup obligations.
Completed-unacknowledged recovery verifies exact cassette bytes before acknowledging exactly once.
A failed interaction emits a terminal event and cannot become a successful replay result.
A cassette manifest binds the plan revision that produced its request and response bytes.
Interrupted artifact preparation exposes no current bytes and recovers atomically for the same attempt.
A changed plan advances one cassette generation while an unchanged sibling remains verified.
Cassette corruption fails closed before a successful replay event becomes visible.
Patch frames are admitted only for the receipt chain of the current playback session.
Nested interception frames unwind in reverse after a journaled interaction failure.
Artifact publication waits for owed cleanup and rollback preserves prior verified bytes.
An acknowledged interaction creates one ordered event batch whose interrupted delivery remains pending.
A stale claimant cannot deliver or acknowledge replay events after ownership transfer.
A transferred session owns one ordered checkpoint, whose completed position causally precedes replay-event visibility.
A multi-response cassette survives serialization, consumes in order, and rewinds without semantic drift.
A filtered request persists and reopens with the same public identity and response bytes.
One successful durable replay closes plan, session, attempt, bytes, cleanup, and delivery receipts.
Replay failure preserves the previous acknowledged generation and a corrected retry publishes once.
Ownership transfer fences stale work and a fresh process resumes the same receipt closure.
Overlapping selection converges while a failed independent interaction cannot pollute the winner.
A handoff during multi-interaction replay resumes from the exact next digest and publishes one causally bound event batch.
A corrupt or cyclic receipt closure fails closed and leaves the last acknowledged replay visible.
